name: City Pulse Multiventures Limited
about: City Pulse Multiventures Limited is a cultural complex, which provides a collection of cinema formats through WOW Cine pulse technology. City Pulse Multiventures Limited was formerly known as City Pulse Multiplex Limited and change its name to City Pulse Multiventures Limited in November 2024. City Pulse Multiventures Limited was incorporated in 2000 and is based in Ahmedabad, India.
